note: Read 2026-11-03 through TanzLII's search, which returns the sections' text (its document pages sit behind a Cloudflare check). Majority: the Age of Majority Act [Cap. 43], s. 2: full age at the beginning of the eighteenth anniversary of birth (s. 3 keeps twenty-one where another Act prescribes it, not held). Work: null. The Employment and Labour Relations Act [Cap. 366], s. 5(1), read the same way, bars employing a child under fourteen, but no rule for a younger performer was read, and the form holds the working age only with it (the blocker papers.ages.blocked.TZ holds the attempts). Service: not read (the game doesn't read service).

sources.title: Age of Majority Act [Cap. 43], s. 2, revised to 31 December 2023 (TanzLII; its search returns the section, the document page /en/akn/tz/act/ord/1960/33/eng@2023-12-31 sitting behind a Cloudflare check)
sources.said: A person domiciled in Tanzania shall attain full age and cease to be under any disability ... of minority at the beginning of the eighteenth anniversary of the day on which he [was born]
